name: mnist-8-real
description: Real-world validation model: MNIST MLP classifier (Conv+Relu+Gemm, no Softmax; outputs logits)

testInput.note: 784 seeded pseudo-random floats (seed 42); argmax digit is 8

notes: CUDA Conv execution requires cuDNN 9.x (libcudnn.so) on the host; without it CUDA fails while CPU succeeds.
